snippet.title: Nimillion - launch date reveal trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for PC Game "Nimillion - The Last Expedition" releasing on Monday 13th of April 2026.

About this PC game:
- A cute, but brutal, rocketship adventure built around realistic and fun physics controls, Metroidvania progression, tough-but-fair level design, huge explorable areas, and proper boss fights. 
- Highly replayable with over 15 hours of gameplay for the main story, speed runs with leaderboard and difficulty levels that change the way you play! Play in both small and huge levels.
- It's made specifically for players who love skill-based challenges without hand-holding. Think classic arcade difficulty with today's polish. Perfect if you ever feel like trying something brutally challenging that rewards pure skill (and gives plenty of "one more try" moments).
- The game can be shorten by using the provided Manual which includes a guide and cheat Maps

🎮Wishlist on Steam now 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2889880/Nimillion__The_last_expedition/
